content.title: Content
content.description: Pick media from Drive, create with apiai.me, and publish or save as drafts — all in one flow.
content.smartBar: Content is the full flow — pick media, create with AI, save drafts and publish.
content.step2: Browse or upload — select what you want to use
content.step3: Create with AI, save to Selected and publish
content.tip: When Drive is connected this guide disappears — the tabs are enough for the flow.
content.liveBrowseMobile: {{count}} media files in view — select what you want to use.
content.liveBrowseDesktop: {{count}} media files in view — J/K browse, S select.
content.liveSelected: {{count}} selected — go to Create or Publish.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Leads, deals and goals — start with the company profile under Company for better AI suggestions.
sales.smartBar: Sales gathers leads, deals and goals — from first contact to close.
sales.step1: Complete the company profile under Company for better AI suggestions
sales.step2: Add leads and follow up what’s overdue
sales.step3: Move deals through the pipeline and measure against your goals
sales.tip: Outreach drafts can be sent on to Content. Fill in Company first so AI suggestions stay relevant.
sales.liveOutreach: {{count}} outreach drafts waiting in the queue

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Several ways to market the company and products — paid, organic, email, e-commerce and partnerships.
marketing.smartBar: Marketing shows campaigns, ad results and what needs action.
marketing.step1: Connect Google Ads and Meta for live campaign data
marketing.step2: Create campaigns or let AI suggest channels and offers
marketing.step3: Send ideas on to Content or E-commerce in one click
marketing.tip: ROAS and spend show when ad accounts are connected and snapshots run.
marketing.liveActiveMobile_one: {{count}} active campaign — swipe or tap to browse.
marketing.liveActiveMobile_other: {{count}} active campaigns — swipe or tap to browse.
marketing.liveActiveDesktop_one: {{count}} active campaign — J/K browse, N new campaign.
marketing.liveActiveDesktop_other: {{count}} active campaigns — J/K browse, N new campaign.
marketing.livePlannedDesktop_one: {{count}} campaign planned — press N for new.
marketing.livePlannedDesktop_other: {{count}} campaigns planned — press N for new.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce
ecommerce.description: Shopify products, orders and recovery in one flow.
ecommerce.descriptionEmpty: Connect Shopify and import products from Alibaba
ecommerce.smartBar: E-commerce gathers Shopify products, orders and recovery in one flow.
ecommerce.step2: Sync products and track orders under Overview
ecommerce.step3: Import from Alibaba or manage the catalog under Products
ecommerce.tip: Shortcuts: O Overview · R Orders · P Products · U Unfulfilled · B Pending pay. Daily automations sync orders and inventory.
ecommerce.liveActions_one: {{count}} action waiting — orders or low stock
ecommerce.liveActions_other: {{count}} actions waiting — orders or low stock
ecommerce.liveOk: No urgent e-commerce actions right now.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Audit log for every change in this business profile.
activity.descriptionMobile: Tap an event in the list to read details.
activity.smartBar: Activity is your audit log — everything that happens in the profile, filterable and searchable.
activity.smartBarMobile: Filter and tap an event to see what happened.
activity.step1: Filter by module or severity to find the right event
activity.step2: Select a row to read details and metadata
activity.step3: Use the log when something looks wrong or you need to trace who did what
activity.stepMobile3: Use the log when something looks wrong
activity.tip: Shortcuts: J/K browse · / search · E errors · W warnings · Esc close.
activity.tipMobile: Here you see what automations and sync did — use filters when something looks odd.
activity.liveErrors: {{count}} errors in the log — start there
activity.pickProfile: Pick a business profile to see the activity feed.

automations.title: Automations
automations.description: Everything that runs automatically for you — pick days, runs per day and run times for each automation.
automations.smartBar: Automations handle the repetitive — snapshots, reminders and sync — so you skip manual upkeep.
automations.step1: See status for each job — last run and next scheduled time
automations.step2: Adjust the schedule (days, times) to how your business works
automations.step3: Follow the “See the result” link to see what the job actually did
automations.tipFailed: Failed runs can usually be retried directly from the job card.
automations.tipOk: Digests, snapshots, AI jobs and sync run on a schedule here — so you skip manual upkeep.
automations.liveFailed: {{count}} jobs failed on the last run — retry from the list or job card.
automations.liveNever: {{count}} jobs have no run history yet — check that the schedule is enabled.

intelligence.title: MCP Intelligence
intelligence.description: One place for all MCP providers — status, queries and clear feedback when API keys or OAuth are missing.
intelligence.smartBar: MCP Intelligence is the control panel for all AI providers — see status, test keys and run queries on your data.
intelligence.hubDescription: {{features}} query tools across {{platforms}} providers. Each field shows auth status before you run a call.
intelligence.overviewHint: Status for every MCP provider. Fix missing API keys or expired OAuth under Connections before running queries in other tabs.
intelligence.step1: Check that providers are green under Connections → MCP
intelligence.step2: Pick a tab for status, compare or a query category
intelligence.step3: Use the answers in Sales, Content or automations
intelligence.tip: Missing a key? Add it under Preferences → API keys.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Plan and schedule events from tasks, leads and connected calendars.
calendar.smartBar: Calendar gathers tasks, lead follow-ups and external calendars — so you see the week in one flow.
calendar.step1: Connect Google or Outlook calendar for sync
calendar.step2: Switch day/week/month and open a day for details
calendar.step3: Create your own events or follow up from Tasks and Sales
calendar.tip: Tasks and leads with dates show automatically in the view.
calendar.liveDue_one: {{count}} task or lead is due today — add it to the calendar
calendar.liveDue_other: {{count}} tasks or leads are due today — add them to the calendar

company.title: Company
company.description: Your company profile steers AI in Sales, outreach and content. Auto-fill with org number, adjust manually, save.
company.smartBar: The company profile gives AI and automations the right context — description, website and goals.
company.step1: Auto-fill with org number or start manually
company.step2: Complete description and audience — that affects AI most
company.step3: Save so Sales and Content get better suggestions right away
company.tip: Start with description (what you sell and to whom), then website and org number. Org number can auto-fill via lookup.
company.liveComplete: Profile looks complete — AI can hit full accuracy.

aiRecommendations.title: AI recommendations
aiRecommendations.description: Data-driven suggestions for this business profile.
aiRecommendations.smartBar: AI suggestions prioritize next steps from your connections, tasks and content.
aiRecommendations.step1: Click Generate to run heuristics + AI on connections, tasks and content
aiRecommendations.step2: Accept to navigate to the right page, or dismiss what doesn’t fit
aiRecommendations.step3: Review accepted and dismissed under the tabs for history
aiRecommendations.tip: New suggestions are automatically marked as seen when you open the page.
